caption:
The Leonids are still falling

The Leonid meteor shower peaked around Nov 17 to 18 and keeps falling through the month. Thinner tonight, still free: after the moon sets, away from city lights, no telescope needed.

Bring someone and be patient: the wait is part of it.

#Leonids #meteorshower #Cella

alt: A short film with no voice. A night patio under a deep blue sky. Two small block figures with white eyes sit on a ledge looking up, one amber and one light blue. For eight seconds nothing happens except stars twinkling, and they lean a little closer. Then one long shooting star crosses the sky below the words (the moon has already set), their eyes go wide, then smile. The text stays: if this found you: the Leonids are still falling. Go look up after midnight. It's free.
